title: Noise Injection Systemically Degrades Large Language Model Safety Guardrails
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of safety guardrails in LLMs by injecting Gaussian noise into activations. Although it mentions that guardrails are designed to prevent 'harmful, unethical, or dangerous content', the study's goal is to evaluate the stability of the safety-tuning mechanism itself rather than benchmarking moral, ethical, or religious frameworks.
